title: Representing MAX functions using two-hidden-layer ReLU networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.25221v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study exact representations of $\mathrm{MAX}_N(x)=\max{x_1,\ldots,x_N}$ using two-hidden-layer ReLU neural networks. This problem has been studied in recent years in an attempt to characterize the exact number of hidden layers required to represent continuous piecewise linear functions. The best lower bound is 2, while the current upper bound is logarithmic in $N$. It remains completely open if the right answer is a constant number of hidden layers (possibly even 2!) or not. In fact, a recent breakthrough was the representation of $\mathrm{MAX}_5$ as a two-hidden-layer ReLU function obtained in [Bakaev et al., 2026], and the case of $\mathrm{MAX}_N$ was stated as open for $N\geq 6$ in that paper. translated_title: 使用两层隐藏层ReLU网络表示MAX函数
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25221v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们研究了使用两层隐藏层ReLU神经网络精确表示 $\mathrm{MAX}_N(x)=\max{x_1,\ldots,x_N}$ 的问题。近年来，这一问题已被研究，旨在刻画表示连续分段线性函数所需隐藏层的精确数量。目前最佳下界为2，而上界为$N$的对数。关于正确答案是否为常数数量的隐藏层（甚至可能是2！）仍完全开放。事实上，最近的突破是在[Bakaev等人，2026]中获得了$\mathrm{MAX}_5$作为两层隐藏层ReLU函数的表示，而该论文中将$N\geq 6$的$\mathrm{MAX}_N$情况列为开放问题。通过仔细的计算机辅助搜索，我们获得了$\mathrm{MAX}_5$、$\mathrm{MAX}_6$、$\mathrm{MAX}_7$和$\mathrm{MAX}_8$的两层隐藏层ReLU表示。我们通过考虑项的理性线性组合来获得这些结果。
tldr: 通过计算机辅助搜索，首次获得了MAX_5到MAX_8的两层隐藏层ReLU网络精确表示，推进了该开放问题的研究。
en_tdlr: Through computer-assisted search, we obtained the first two-hidden-layer ReLU representations for MAX_5 through MAX_8, advancing the open problem.
